name: print-social-participate-restaurant-flyer-blue-dotted-line-illustration
title: 'Participate! Share our food dishes and win' flyer with blue dotted-line doodles over a real dining photo
whatItIs: A blue-bordered white flyer with a bold coral 'Participate!' headline, a photo of two people sharing sushi and taking phone photos of their food, overlaid with blue dotted-line doodles: a grid, a jellyfish, a bowl outline and a starburst pointing at the plate.
whatItMeans: Playful and social; simple dotted doodles turn an ordinary dining photo into an active call to share and participate.
techniques: Overlay simple dotted-line doodles onto a real photo.
Point a starburst doodle at the exact detail to notice.
Keep the doodle colour separate from the photo for clarity.

vocabulary.definition: A simple broken-line drawing overlaid on other content.
Content created and shared by customers rather than the brand.
